scientific_question: Does the closed HDP loop H -> omega -> W -> X -> I_rec -> H produce bounded dynamics with timescale-separated parameter retention and history-dependent future response?

closed_system.rbd_f1_linearization: tau_H * dh_i/dt = -h_i + kappa_H * delta_I_i,  h_i = H_i - 1
closed_system.plasticity: tau_W * domega_ij/dt = kappa_W * (H_i - H_j) - lambda_W * omega_ij

dangerous_loop: h_A - h_B -> omega -> delta_W -> delta_I -> h_A - h_B

stability_gate.requirement: max_k Re(lambda_k(J)) < 0 at equilibrium for nominal W3 parameter set
stability_gate.jacobian: J = d(dot_X) / dX |_{X^*} for smallest reduced deterministic linearization
reduced_state_example: omega = omega_AB (with omega_BA = -omega_AB under symmetric W1b convention)
optional synaptic filter state z_AB for linearized presynaptic-postsynaptic coupling

schematic_2x2_block.gain_g_syn: linearized map from delta_W_AB to antisymmetric delta_I at equilibrium; must be identified before implementation from Izhikevich+synapse linearization
schematic_2x2_block.characteristic_note: 2x2 Jacobian eigenvalues set closed-loop stability margin; full state Jacobian may be larger but must satisfy same gate

stability_gate.blocking_rule: Do not implement W3 simulation until stability analysis receipt is written and nominal parameters pass the gate

timescale_hierarchy.rationale: parameter memory must not forget faster than the RBS state that wrote it
timescale_hierarchy.lambda_W_zero: supported boundary regime (permanent omega) but not primary W3 demonstration

reduction_null_regimes.expected_reduction: exact RBD / Protocol H substrate; omega frozen at initial value
reduction_null_regimes.purpose: isolate H <-> X loop without plastic writing

reduction_null_regimes.expected_reduction: H -> omega -> W -> X expression without recurrent activity feeding back into H
reduction_null_regimes.purpose: isolate plastic expression path without RBS closure

reduction_null_regimes.expected_behavior: full closed HDP loop; subject to stability gate

phases: perturbation: localized RBS pulse on A (or prescribed delta_H)
relaxation: free evolution until H_perturbed ~ H_control
probe: identical input to perturbed and control; compare omega, H, X

required: bounded closed-loop dynamics (no runaway omega or H)
timescale-separated parameter retention: omega_perturbed != omega_control after H equilibration
history-dependent neural response: X_perturbed != X_control under identical probe input
H_perturbed approximately equals H_control at probe time (fast state faded)
success_criteria.interpretation: fast hidden-state memory has faded, but slower parameter trace changes future neural response

failure_criteria: max Re(lambda(J)) >= 0 under nominal parameters (unstable equilibrium)
runaway |omega| or non-finite H during perturbation-relaxation-probe
probe response identical despite omega separation (expression failure)
H not equilibrated between perturbed and control at probe (confounded fast memory)

forbidden_shortcuts: Tuning kappa_W, kappa_H, lambda_W, tau_W, or probe parameters after observing W3 memory outcome
Using lambda_W = 0 as the only W3 success demonstration
Skipping stability Jacobian receipt before implementation
Reopening W2 frozen configuration or receipts during W3 debugging
